long_biography.plain_text:
Working from Penang, Christophe Albin built ESCATEC around contract electronics for original-equipment manufacturers. His engineering background shaped a business that combined design, prototyping, circuit-board assembly, microelectronics and full product manufacture rather than competing solely on volume.

Albin financed the company without external capital and expanded it through production sites in Malaysia and Europe. He also added plastic injection moulding, medical manufacturing and a Swiss microelectronics operation. In 2023 he moved from executive chairmanship to a board role, remaining involved in oversight and support as the group entered its second generation of family leadership.
